card.name: The word or after cause-of-death lists
card.fires_on: The word "or" right after a parenthetical list of cardiovascular death causes, in the standard label sentence on causes of death in treated versus placebo patients. Also a space before a number after a dash in suicide-rate statistics.

modes.label: Or after cardiovascular deaths
modes.description: The word "or" that follows "cardiovascular (e.g., heart failure, sudden death)" and leads into infectious causes.
modes.example: most of the deaths appeared to be either cardiovascular (e.g., heart failure, sudden death)<< or>> infectious (e.g., pneumonia) in

modes.label: Space before a suicide rate
modes.description: A space after a dash and before a rate figure in suicide statistics.
modes.example: The highest suicide rate was for white men older than 85 years of age --<< >>65.3 per 10

card.plain: It marks the spot in the familiar sentence on causes of death where "or" introduces infectious causes.
evidence: most of the deaths appeared to be either cardiovascular (e.g., heart failure, sudden death)<< or>> infectious (e.g., pneumonia) in
